## Ledger

**OB-1 — the violator** (projection updated in place, slots overwritten and appended, nothing removed): **CLOSED** — `packages/svelte-query/src/useMutationState.svelte.ts` (TanStack/query). Read verbatim at 29–41: `Object.assign(result, nextResult)` copies index 0…n−1 into the `$state` array and never shortens `result.length`, so a shrunk mutation cache leaves the tail of the previous, longer list still present and still reactive. Its five siblings all converge: react/preact return a fresh `replaceEqualDeep` snapshot, solid `setResult(nextResult)`, vue `state.value = getResult(...)`, lit `setResult(replaceEqualDeep(...))`. Within the same package, `createQueries.svelte.ts` → `containers.svelte.ts` `createRawRef.update` deletes the keys that are gone and decrements `length` — the in-repo proof this is an omission, not a style.

**OB-2 — incremental builder recording additions *and* removals, still yielding the whole**: **CLOSED** — `packages/store/src/lib/IncrementalSetConstructor.ts` (tldraw). Read 21–101: separate `diff.added` / `diff.removed` sets maintained as items arrive, opposing ops cancelled, and `get()` returns `{ value, diff }` — the whole set alongside the delta.

**OB-3 — keyed render pass that drops elements whose keys are gone**: **CLOSED** — `packages/react-reconciler/src/ReactChildFiber.js` (react). Read verbatim at 448–454 and 1262–1274: the keyed array pass ends with `if (newIdx === newChildren.length) { deleteRemainingChildren(returnFiber, oldFiber) }`, and every non-matching key path falls through to `deleteRemainingChildren`.

No obligation is open.
